The Yousem pathologic-predictor study's alternative reading is recorded: progressive cases' background scarring may itself represent a BOOP-like reaction pattern in underlying usual interstitial pneumonia; if a qualified human finds cohort data resolving this confound, the tier may be revisited.
governanceNotes: Authored conservatively at ASSOCIATION_ONLY strength: the documented outcome literature shows most COP responds to corticosteroids (>80%), with progressive disease confined to a minority whose biopsies show background parenchymal scarring, and the fulminant subset is rare; the pathway is real but small-subset and confounded by possible underlying UIP.

Misclassification guard recorded: the COP-with-fibrosis presentation overlaps with fibrosing interstitial pneumonias that merely organize secondarily, so fibrosis after COP cannot be attributed to the COP episode without pathology review and multidisciplinary diagnosis; this boundary is built into the evidence gaps.

nexusClaim.associationBasis: The pathologic-predictor case-control matched steroid-responsive against progressive idiopathic BOOP/COP: progressive cases showed scarring and remodeling of the background parenchyma in 89% versus 10% of good-prognosis cases, with the authors noting steroid-nonresponsive cases may cause irreversible injury or represent a BOOP/COP-like reaction in associated fibrosing pneumonia, especially UIP (Yousem 1997); the rapidly progressive series described a fulminant subset dying of or surviving with chronic severe fibrosis and marked impairment (Cohen 1994); the exacerbation review documents OP as one pole of the acute-injury spectrum that can accompany or presage fibrosing ILD (Kershaw 2021).
nexusClaim.causationStatus: Neither causation nor aggravation is established at the mapping level: more than 80% of COP responds to steroids with resolution, the fibrotic outcomes concentrate in a small progressive subset, and the decisive confound is that background scarring at diagnosis may reflect underlying UIP misclassified as COP, so no directional claim is made here.

causalMechanism.primaryVector: A repair-process-overshoot pathway is hypothesized: organizing pneumonia represents exuberant granulation-tissue (Masson body) responses within alveolar ducts and spaces; in the minority of patients in whom the injury continues, intraluminal fibrosis extends to alveolar-septal inflammation and irreversible remodeling with fibrotic honeycombing, converting a theoretically reversible pattern into permanent fibrotic restriction. The mechanism is pathologically documented in the progressive subset, but most cases resolve and the progressive subset is confounded by possible underlying UIP, so no directional claim is made here.

evidentiaryProfile.conservativeRationale: This relationship is supported as an association only. A minority of organizing-pneumonia courses end in persistent fibrosis, documented pathologically and in fulminant case series; individual determination requires surgical-biopsy confirmation of the OP pattern, serial imaging and pulmonary-function documentation of persistent fibrosis, exclusion of underlying UIP or NSIP, and review by a qualified medical professional.
evidentiaryProfile.evidenceGaps: Surgical lung biopsy or cryobiopsy with multidisciplinary pathology review establishing the organizing-pneumonia pattern and any background fibrosis; serial high-resolution CT documenting persistence or progression of fibrosis after treatment; pulmonary-function trend documenting restriction or reduced diffusing capacity; treatment history including corticosteroid response; exclusion of UIP, NSIP, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, drug-induced fibrosis, and connective-tissue disease; a medical professional's opinion connecting the documented findings in this individual case
alternativeEtiologiesToRuleOut: Usual interstitial pneumonia presenting with a superimposed organizing pattern (the misclassification confound)
Nonspecific interstitial pneumonia with fibrotic features
Drug-induced interstitial lung disease and fibrosis

suggestions.rationale: Authored conservatively at association-only strength: the fibrotic outcome is pathologically documented in the progressive minority, the majority resolve, and the UIP-misclassification confound is explicit in the source literature itself; the edge records the subset pathway only and leaves every individual determination to a qualified medical professional.
